objective: Prepare Slowqueen for Whitney, preserve Curse, retain long-term team; acquire Headbutt and Confusion, train Flaaffy toward Thunder Wave when feasible
authorization: Pedro requests full preparation and LLM visual verification instead of bespoke detectors (2026-10-05); Pedro permits grouping predictable actions and inference rather than reading every frame
productAndroidBackends: remain read-only; closed research runner uses independently packaged original FNaF transport and lease algorithms

sameTransportRepeatedBlock.everyContact: new native capture, inferred continuation, fresh foreground guard, common executor; release after every contact
sameTransportRepeatedBlock.purpose: avoid reopening HID between predictable dialog/Headbutt actions; no autonomous semantic stop

method: Session LLM reads native image, records scene, intended action and evidence. Common executor dispatches exactly one bounded contact. Result stays UNKNOWN until the next LLM image assessment, stored separately; dispatch is never a successful game action.
calibration: Menu directions exercised in prior experiments. Left/Right must be visually qualified on first use. Nominal 150ms is not measured app landing duration. Longer navigation-only holds are bounded experiments; visually verify first effect. No fixed tile count inferred.
guards: One original lease per complete action/capture
Fresh reviewed image, bound hash, one-use
Input release and process close in finally
Pause and reacquire on unknown scene or external interruption
gameConstraints: Do not withdraw from Day Care at level 20 or above without move-queue analysis
No purchase or use of scarce battle items without concrete need
No save edits, ROM edits, cheats, reset or state restore
measurementLimits: LLM judgments are nonblinded and fallible
Foreground and pixels are sequential witnesses
No deterministic unattended farming or generic vision claim
rawEvidence: ignored .operator only; sanitized manifests and narrative may be committed
inference: A bounded LLM-authored sequence may use inferred scene decisions. Each dispatch/capture stays serialized and recorded, and unreviewed outcomes remain UNKNOWN. Stop at learning, battle choice, low HP or unexpected scene. Controller must identify visual vs inferred decisions.
speedTrial: Historical 2x trial completed; Fast forward is now OFF by user preference. Faster factors unqualified.
